info.title: Mission Control API
info.description: AI Agent Orchestration Platform API. In MC_AUTH_MODE=openclaw-loopback, OpenClaw is the only external user-authentication boundary; this service accepts loopback HTTP only and disables local login, session, proxy-header, global-key and agent-key authentication.

get.summary: Get attribution report for an agent
get.description: Self-scope by default. Requester must match target agent (`x-agent-name` or username), unless admin uses `?privileged=1`.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Time window in hours, integer range 1..720. Defaults to 24.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Comma-separated subset of identity,audit,mutations,cost. Defaults to all.

parameters.name: privileged
parameters.description: Set to 1 for admin override of self-scope checks.

parameters.name: x-agent-name
parameters.description: Attribution identity header used for self-scope authorization.

get.summary: Get self diagnostics for an agent
get.description: Self-scoped diagnostics by default. Cross-agent access requires `privileged=1` with admin credentials. Trend alerts are informational signals derived from current-vs-previous window deltas (error spikes, throughput drops, activity stalls).

parameters.name: privileged
parameters.description: Set to `1` to allow explicit admin cross-agent diagnostics access.

post.summary: Trigger an enabled n8n workflow binding

directorWork.description: Optional director-brain work name or alias for video analysis. When present, input.materialId is required and must be a stable material identity; the server resolves and stores the stable work binding.

materialId.description: Stable material identity; required whenever directorWork is present.

200.description: The idempotency key already completed; returns the cached task output

202.description: The task was accepted, an existing run was returned, or delivery outcome is unknown and remains safely queued

409.description: Workflow binding is disabled, the idempotency key already belongs to a failed or cancelled task, or its director work/material binding differs

423.description: New task intake is paused or the shared deployment lock is busy; existing executions and callbacks remain available

500.description: n8n accepted the webhook but durable local dispatch settlement failed; retry with the same task identity

502.description: n8n returned an explicit non-retryable 4xx rejection

503.description: An internal callback URL is unsafe, or the shared deployment lock cannot be safely acquired or released

post.summary: Claim a persisted top-level n8n task
post.description: Internal n8n callback that atomically binds an exact workspace-scoped top-level task to one stable n8n execution owner before any child nodes execute. A lost response may be retried only by that same execution owner.

200.description: The parent was claimed or the same workflow delivery already owns it

409.description: Terminal task or identity, scope, binding, execution ownership, or top-level source mismatch

post.summary: Execute one persisted n8n model node
post.description: Internal loopback callback used by the bundled multi-model workflow. The selected route is resolved from the external registry and persisted task routing.

finalizeParent.description: May be true only when nodeKey is the controlled reviewer node.

200.description: The node succeeded or a persisted node/parent result was returned

409.description: Invalid parent state, idempotency mismatch, or unavailable route

502.description: Model execution failed and will not be replayed automatically

503.description: The child is still running; retry until a cached terminal result is returned

post.description: Internal loopback callback used by the bundled video workflow. Prepare, audio, vision, and finalize stages persist operational task results but never receive an OpenClaw session or memory context.

200.description: The stage succeeded, a cached stage was returned, or the parent was finalized

409.description: Invalid parent state, idempotency mismatch, or unavailable worker

502.description: Media preparation or stateless model execution failed

503.description: The media child is still running; retry until a cached terminal result is returned

post.summary: Execute an explicitly legacy-v1 persisted task through local OpenClaw
post.description: Legacy loopback compatibility callback. It fails closed unless the persisted task explicitly declares callbackProtocol=legacy-v1 and the current process is a non-slot legacy runtime. Blue-green slot-v1 tasks must use claim plus node-execute/media-execute ownership and fencing.

200.description: Local OpenClaw execution succeeded or a completed result was returned

202.description: The same task is already running

409.description: Idempotency mismatch, exhausted retries, or invalid run state

502.description: OpenClaw execution failed; response reports whether another retry remains

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: When provided, returns only the matching workspace-scoped task run.

post.summary: Reconcile an active video parent against its server-side callback lease
post.description: The server owns lease and child-run eligibility rules. Callers submit only the parent task identifier.

200.description: Current terminal/active state, including whether an expired orphan was reconciled

code.description: VIDEO_CALLBACK_LEASE_EXPIRED when reconciliation fails an orphaned parent.

409.description: The task is not a reconcilable video run

credentialReference.description: External environment variable name only; never the credential value.

config.description: Non-secret workflow settings only; credentials must be stored outside this binding.
